evidence_requirements.description: Screenshot of your terminal showing the output of `uv run hf --version` and `uv run hf classify ...`
Pasted command output plus written usability feedback (at least 60 words in total)

acceptance_criteria.statement: Submission fulfils the request as described
Exact output of `cmd /c ver` is pasted (Microsoft Windows [Version ...])
`uv run hf classify` output shows category physical_action
Feedback names at least one concrete thing that was confusing, slow, or broken, or states specifically why nothing was
Optional: `uv run pytest` summary line is pasted (N passed)
